content.summary: Brown-Forman Corporation has reported past second-quarter 2026 earnings to October 31, 2025, with sales of US$1,036 million and net income of US$224 million, both lower than the same period a year earlier. content.title: BTIG thinks Apple stock is poised to drop, PepsiCo nears settlement
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Allie Canal track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Apple (AAPL) as BTIG analysts believe the iPhone maker's stock is due for a drop, reports that PepsiCo (PEP) is nearing a settlement agreement with activist investor Elliott Management, and Brown-Forman Corporation (BF-B, BF-A) warning of a challenging landscape to come in 2026.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
